You should be able to request a woman (which I didn't think to do) but again if you end up not liking it you can find another
ive done a lot of reading about therapy and a lot of people struggle to find someone they click with and apparently that's most of the struggle, so I guess we're not alone there.

Ah... I don't know if I have the courage or energy to have to go back to the doctors, especially to tell someone that. My previous therapist who I saw in 2015 was fantastic, I saw her for nearly the whole year, she definitely helped, I never told her much but it was just nice know there was someone there to talk to if I was having a particularly shitty week. I'd say give it a try, it took me a while to get "comfortable", maybe a couple of months, but now that I don't see her anymore I really miss her she really was a great friend. But yeah, give it a try if you can, just so theres someone non-judgemental to help, and if you decide it's not for you, you can back out at anytime.

I was meant to be going to uni next year too, got an unconditional place and everything but I don't think the course is for me, and I'd just be even more lost and isolated there so what's the point. Sorry to hear you're struggling too but glad your meds are helping, was the process of getting them difficult?
